INSERT INTO message_participant (id, conversation_id, participant_type, participant_id, participant_name, participant_avatar, last_read_seq, joined_time, participant_status, notification_enabled, tenant_id, create_by, create_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{participant.id}, #{participant.conversationId}, #{participant.participantType}, #{participant.participantId}, #{participant.participantName}, #{participant.participantAvatar}, #{participant.lastReadSeq}, #{participant.joinedTime}, #{participant.participantStatus}, #{participant.notificationEnabled}, #{participant.tenantId}, #{participant.createBy}, #{participant.createTime}, #{participant.delFlag}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE participant_status = 'ACTIVE', exited_time = NULL,
participant_name = COALESCE(VALUES(participant_name), participant_name), participant_avatar = COALESCE(VALUES(participant_avatar), participant_avatar),
last_read_seq = VALUES(last_read_seq), joined_time = VALUES(joined_time), update_time = NOW(), del_flag = '0'
